intro-kop: Your hotel in Venray, close to Boxmeer
intro-p1: Hotel Asteria is at Maasheseweg 80a in Venray, about 15 minutes by car (15 km) from the centre of Boxmeer. You stay in a four-star hotel right on the A73, park free of charge at the door and have our own wellness area with four saunas on the top floor.
intro-p2: From the hotel you are soon in the Steenstraat and the Weijerpark in Boxmeer, or in the Maasheggen: the centuries-old hedge landscape along the Maas, a UNESCO biosphere reserve since 2018. Overloon is even closer: the drive to Oorlogsmuseum Overloon, the Overloon War Museum, takes 9 minutes, to ZooParc 11 minutes.

faq-1-1-v: How far is Hotel Asteria from Boxmeer?
faq-1-1-a: About 15 minutes by car, around 15 kilometres to the centre of Boxmeer. The hotel is right on the A73 near Venray.
faq-1-2-v: What is there to do around Boxmeer?
faq-1-2-a: In Boxmeer itself you can shop in the Steenstraat and walk in the Weijerpark. Along the Maas lie the Maasheggen, a centuries-old landscape of woven hedges and a UNESCO biosphere reserve since 2018; from the hotel it is a quarter of an hour's drive. In Overloon you will find the War Museum and ZooParc, 9 and 11 minutes from the hotel.
faq-1-3-v: Can I get to Boxmeer by train or by bike?
faq-1-3-a: Boxmeer and Venray are both on the Maaslijn between Nijmegen and Venlo. By bike it is about 13 kilometres, roughly 55 minutes. At the hotel your bike can stay in a locked bike shed.
faq-2-1-v: Is there a package with the War Museum?
faq-2-1-a: Yes, the War Museum package: one night in a Comfort room, admission to the museum with coffee or tea in the museum café, a three-course dinner and the breakfast buffet. Let us know the day of your museum visit and we reserve your tickets.
faq-2-2-v: Can I park at the hotel?
faq-2-2-a: Yes, free of charge, right on the A73 (exit 8, Venray-Noord). There are four charging points for electric cars.
faq-2-3-v: Does the hotel have its own wellness area?
faq-2-3-a: Yes, at the top of the building: 300 m² with four saunas, a steam cabin and a plunge and herbal bath. Open Monday to Thursday 4 pm-10 pm and Friday to Sunday 12 noon-10 pm. Hotel guests pay € 12.50 per person; reserve your time in advance at reception.
